REDACT_PDF_API_KEY.title: Redact PDF AI API key
REDACT_PDF_API_KEY.description: Your API key from https://www.redact-pdf.ai/dashboard/settings. Optional: without one, the keyless try_demo tool still works, so you can verify the server before signing up.

REDACT_PDF_BASE_URL.title: API base URL
REDACT_PDF_BASE_URL.description: Point at a different API host. Defaults to https://www.redact-pdf.ai
